label: MikroTik GPERx6 (CSS606)
description: Outdoor Layer-2 switch: 3x gigabit with PoE-out on 2, 3x SFP+, and 802.3bt PoE input.
notes: Vendor figures from the MikroTik product page specification table: 3x 10/100/1000 Ethernet ports, **1 with Reverse PoE (PoE-in) and 2 with PoE-out** (Ether2-Ether3, passive PoE up to 57 V), 3x SFP+ ports (10G), PoE in 802.3bt, Max total out 2.4 A, Total output power 150 W. Ether1 is the powered input, not a PSE; the 802.3bt standard is the unit's input, the output is fixed-voltage passive.

poe.note: Total output power 150 W on the two passive PoE-out ports (Ether2-Ether3, 2.4 A max total out, low-voltage limit 1.2 A / high-voltage 0.625 A). The unit is itself PoE-powered (802.3bt on Ether1), so the pass-through ceiling is set by the input: Max power consumption 160 W, 6 W without attachments.
